mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS sessionId, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.price, s.language_version AS languageVersion, h.name, h.capacity, h.seat_layout AS seatLayout, h.location FROM session s JOIN hall h ON h.id = s.hall_id WHERE s.movie_id = #{id} ORDER BY s.start_time ASC

SELECT s.id AS sessionId, m.name AS movieName, m.poster_url AS posterUrl, h.name AS hallName, h.location AS location, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.price AS price, s.language_version AS languageVersion, h.seat_layout AS seatLayout, h.capacity AS capacity FROM session s JOIN movie m ON m.id = s.movie_id JOIN hall h ON h.id = s.hall_id WHERE s.id = #{sessionId}
